documents.text: Guwahati International Film Festival The Guwahati International Film Festival (GIFF) () is an annual film festival held in Guwahati, Assam, India.The State Government-owned Jyoti Chitraban (Film Studio) Society organised the festival in association with the Dr. Bhupen Hazarika Regional Government Film and Television Institute. The first ever Guwahati International Film Festival (GIFF) to be held in northeast India, which will be inaugurated on October 28, 2017 by Assam Chief Minister Sarbananda Sonowal.
